Connect the camera to Wi-Fi
Adjust the settings according to your needs
Activate alerts and motion tracking
Of course, you can run more than one camera on the same phone and through the same app.
Based on the instruction manual, here is the guide and method:
1. The guide from the manual (page 08 - fifth image):
In step 7 of the setup (Name the device), the app asks you to name the camera (e.g., Garage, Front door, Living room). This option is specifically for distinguishing between cameras because the app is designed to manage multiple cameras in different places (one in the garage, one in the living room, etc.) at the same time.
2. How to add a second camera?
The method is simple and is done by repeating the same setup steps you did for the first camera:
Open the app's main page.
Look for the (+) sign, usually at the top of the screen, to add a new device (Add Device).
Follow the same connection steps mentioned on pages 5, 6, and 7 (connecting the power, hearing the tone, entering the Wi-Fi password, scanning the code).
Finally, name the second camera with a different name than the first (e.g., "Home entrance" instead of "Office").
Additional note:
The manual also explains on page 12 (second image) and page 9 (eighth image) the "Device Sharing" feature, which allows you to share the camera with family members so they can watch the same camera from their own phones, which means the system is very flexible (multiple cameras on one phone, or one camera on multiple phones).
